description: This PHP file contains a unit test class for the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class in the OrangeHRM Dashboard Plugin. It tests methods related to retrieving employee attendance records, using PHPUnit framework and custom test utilities.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao, testing retrieval of employee attendance records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates DAO instance, sets fixture path, and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the latest attendance record for a specific employee number, asserting various properties of the record.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Tests retrieval of attendance records for an employee within a date range, verifying count and record details.
